## What's fixed

- **No more stutter around InjeKt blends.** Matching tempos meant changing a track's speed bit by bit while it played: before the blend, the playing track was eased toward the next one's tempo, and afterwards the new track was eased back to its own. On iPhone, every one of those small speed changes made the player rebuffer for a moment, so you heard dozens of tiny hiccups around each blend. Now a track's speed is never changed while it plays: the next track starts at the tempo of the one playing, lines up on the bar as before, and keeps that tempo until it ends. The next blend meets it there, the way a DJ keeps a set at one tempo. Tracks too far apart in tempo are blended without matching, at their own speed.
- **Smoother playback in general.** The part that fades, swaps the bass and applies the equaliser runs right where the sound is made, and it could wait on the rest of the app or set aside memory while doing so, which can make the sound drop out for an instant at any point in a song. It now never waits and never sets aside memory there, and a plain fade takes a fraction of the work it did.
- **The next tracks are analysed after a blend, not during it,** so the phone has its hands free while both tracks are playing.

The "Meet in the middle" and "Tempo share" settings are gone from Settings → InjeKt, as the playing track no longer changes tempo.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
